public_payload.normalized_proposition: In Q3 2026 Anthropic's revenue grew about 46.9% from the prior quarter while its compute costs rose about 77.4%.

statement.excerpt: While revenue grew about 46.9% ($11.5 billion to a little under $17 billion) quarter-over-quarter, compute costs nearly doubled from $5.6bn to $9.9bn (about 77.4%).

from_speaker: $11.5 billion to a little under $17 billion
our_interpretation: The comparison is Q3 2026 against Q2 2026.
Compute costs means the filing's compute and infrastructure expense line.
About permits small rounding discrepancies; for this assessment, a difference below 0.5 percentage points is immaterial.
Nearly doubled is read alongside the explicit 77.4% figure, not as a separate promise of 100% growth.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable company-reported quarterly figures produce revenue growth within 0.5 percentage points of 46.9% and compute expense growth within 0.5 percentage points of 77.4%, with amounts approximately as stated.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable figures materially differ from either stated growth rate or amount, or the comparison combines incompatible periods or metrics.
